name: Goldener Engl
beschreibung: The Goldener Engl is a hotel in Hall in Tirol, Tirol. It is located in the Old Town of Hall, which is known for its well-preserved medieval architecture. The hotel combines historic architecture with modern comfort features. Amenities include a restaurant and free Wi-Fi. The rooms are furnished with contemporary furniture. The surroundings offer access to cultural and historical sites. Hall train station is nearby, making arrival easier.
